claim_boundary: This is a contact-guided CDR sequence-proposal integration protocol. It is not structural diffusion, does not establish affinity or binding, and is not comparable to experimentally validated RFdiffusion/RFantibody design.

gates.name: G0_implementation
requirements: only canonical amino-acid tokens are generated inside the frozen CDR mask
fixed seeds reproduce identical ranked proposals
empty hotspot and non-finite score paths fail closed

gates.name: G1_train_only_matched_control
requirements: a training-only CDR denoiser checkpoint is frozen
guided and unguided samplers use matched proposal budgets and seeds
framework preservation, validity, novelty, diversity, hotspot score, and off-target score are reported

gates.name: G2_low_homology_antibody_adaptation
requirements: indivisible components produce a feasible split
independent four-view audit reports zero crossings
no opened external cohort is used for selection

gates.name: G3_biological_validation
requirements: orthogonal structure and developability filters frozen before opening
experimental binding validation for any functional design claim

method.contact_objective: mean sigmoid pair score over CDR-by-hotspot edges minus a frozen off-target penalty
